crossRefs.note: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”
He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to…
The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.
In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.
He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back…
Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go…
“Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing…
It will happen that, when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must…
It will happen in that day, that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision, when he prophesies; neither will they…
But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”
translations.bsb: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau, your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may bless me.”
